text: Cinematic sci-fi concept art of a futuristic desert metropolis at dusk. In the foreground left, a cloaked figure in maroon stands with a brown alpaca on a golden sand dune, facing the city. A curved highway with glowing yellow lane markers winds toward a bright turquoise oasis pool on the right. Beside the pool, a tall saguaro cactus is outlined in neon pink light. The background features a sprawling neon city with three main spires. The central, tallest tower has a glowing cyan ring hovering above it. The left tower displays a vertical neon sign reading 'OASIS'. The right tower glows purple. Cyan laser beams shoot upward from the buildings into the sky. The sky is a gradient of sunset orange to deep starry blue, featuring a large crescent moon in the upper left. High contrast, detailed textures, 8k resolution.
